message.content: Buddhism was founded by **Siddhārtha Gautāma**, who later became known as the **Buddha** (“Enlightened One”). He was born in what is now modern‑day *Lumbini* in southern Nepal (circa 563 CE). After attaining enlightenment under the bodhi tree near *Sarnath*, north of Varanasi in northern India, he began teaching his insights—forming the basis of Buddhist doctrine—and thus established Buddhism in the broader Indian subcontinent.
